llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic issue: Evaluator only checks if ANY image on slide 2 has dimensions 1.5cm x 1.5cm, but does NOT verify that the specific image 'none.png' was added

Missing requirement coverage: Instruction explicitly requires adding 'none.png', but evaluator cannot distinguish between 'none.png' and any other image with the same dimensions
Edge case failure: If multiple images exist on slide 2, the getter only checks the first one, which may not be the newly added 'none.png'

Alternative approach 2: Implement before/after comparison - count images on slide 2 before and after task, verify exactly one new image was added with correct dimensions
